notablePrerequisites:
Olivia does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
description:
Declare Olivia as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block your creatures.
Olivia triggers, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
Port Razer enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Deal combat damage with Port Razer, triggering its ability, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Port Razer, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
